openclaw.title: Associate review form labels with inputs
openclaw.instructions: Edit src/components/ServiceReviewsPanel.tsx. For accessible unique form labels, import useId from react and call it once unconditionally near the other hooks: const reviewFormId = useId();. Add htmlFor={reviewFormId + '-rating'} to the Rating label and id={reviewFormId + '-rating'} to its select. Add htmlFor={reviewFormId + '-comment'} to the Comment label and id={reviewFormId + '-comment'} to its input. Do not change any behavior, text, handlers or API calls. Multiple panels must have different IDs; do not use hardcoded global IDs. Use the edit tool and stop after success.
openclaw.commit_message: fix(reviews): associate form labels with unique control ids

hermes.title: Preserve explicitly supplied empty RPC object parameters
hermes.instructions: Fix acp_rpc_call in app/services/acp_rpc.py: currently params or [] incorrectly converts an explicitly supplied empty dict to a list. Change only that body field to params if params is not None else []. Preserve all other behavior. Append a standalone regression test to tests/test_acp_rpc_headers.py, preserving EVERY existing test unchanged. Use monkeypatch plus asyncio.run; mock get_settings with a simple object whose acp_rpc_url is http://unit.invalid; mock httpx.AsyncClient with an async context manager and async post recording json, returning an object whose json method returns {'result': 'ok'}. No real network/DB. Call acp_rpc_call with {}, [], and None and assert recorded params are {}, [], [] respectively and calls return ok. Import only asyncio and the acp_rpc module as needed; no os, file operations, subprocess or network calls. Finish immediately after editing both files.

required: params if params is not None else []

hermes.commit_message: fix(rpc): preserve empty object parameters in JSON RPC calls
